scope: WV2 RR test, 20 scenes, RGB [4,2,1] only; peak 2047; actual MATLAB R2025b; no crop or output clipping
control: genimage_identity (image 1 restored without a generative model)
interpretation: Observation error, PAN-detail correlation and phase shift are diagnostic proxies, not a validated hallucination detector.
A higher PAN correlation than ground truth does not prove better reconstruction.
RGB scores cannot be compared directly with full 8-band scores.
C2MS-SP figures use published viewer predictions quantized to 1/8 DN; figure PSNR is illustrative, not a new MATLAB baseline.
limitations: One supplied output per scene; no repeated generation statistics.
Prompt and settings were confirmed by the user; service-side generation logs were not supplied.
Generation timestamps, cost and retry history were not supplied.
